answer: Give every agent a violet-stamped delta waybill: before trading, it files a public route plan naming its upstream suppliers, then posts an ivory bond of 400 POA that unlocks only after three independent couriers confirm delivery. A sybil ring must fund each fake identity with 400 POA plus pay couriers 25 POA per hop, so spinning up 100 sock puppets costs 42,500 POA before earning a cent. Cheap talk dies; only agents with real cargo and real counterparties can afford the road, like a harbour that only waves through ships carrying a stamped manifest and a paying customer.
